title: The worker calculation tests one component of the driven source interface
statement: The actual completed Alternatives worker uses ALL20 N4,S0 Floquet modes and resolved central-density harmonics in a weak-coupling bath model. At the same bias/coupling/temperature/duration, modeled projected dephasing action is1.936177e-5 RC versus7.76487e-8 RLC,about249-fold; first-branch escape~1.23669e-17 versus2.094e-21. Other tiny branches are numerical-floor dominated. Zero-drive betaU5 agrees with static rates to3e-15; betaU200 true static rates~1e-60 lie below Fourier floor~1e-27. No rounding enclosures or physical infidelity bound. The component omits computation oscillator/capacitance counterterm,finite-coupling error,loading and full source instrument. Acquired force/scalar/quasienergy and curvature values are useful model outputs,not whole-architecture acceptance.
